task: Primary longitudinal2.5D literature research and contrast with5mR2 frozen tube
source_policy: Primary papers, author thesis, official repositories. Ocelot official documentation was examined for implementation only; its displayed derivation has apparent errors and is not used for equations.

sources.title: Space Charge Modules for PyHEADTAIL
facts: Longitudinal module uses an equivalent line-density derivative field; derivation starts from a uniform round ellipsoid with parabolic line density.
Conducting round-pipe validity stated as bunch half-length zm>3rp; averaged g=.67+2ln(rp/rb).
g0=6.36 appears as free-space value for the Figure1 example; paper does not establish a universal open-space constant.
The SPS experimental benchmark is transverse resonance-driven blow-up, not sharp-ended cold-tube longitudinal fringes.
contrast_inference: Our constant-section, sharp-ended free-space cold source does not match the smooth equivalent-ellipsoid/ring assumptions. Overall L/a is insufficient to validate end fields.

sources.title: Space Charge Effects and Advanced Modelling for CERN Low Energy Machines
facts: Free-space ellipsoid g0 explicitly depends on aspect parameter chi=sqrt(1-rb^2/zm^2).
Equation3.19: g0(chi)=2/chi^2 * [atanh(chi)/chi -1].
The g0=6.36 comparison uses an SPS Gaussian example at injection gamma=27.72 and32 slices.
Pipe longitudinal model averages transverse amplitudes; 3D model resolves the spread.
contrast_inference: OPALX OpenG0=6.36 is a hardcoded value equal to this example, but no universal justification follows. Equality and source-code reference establish a provenance clue, not proof of original developer intent.

sources.title: Form Factor g In Longitudinal Space Charge Impedance
facts: Round beam inside concentric grounded round pipe; longitudinal force averaged over transverse distribution is distinguished from on-axis force.
Uniform transverse density gives on-axis constant1 and averaged constant.5 in g=constant+2ln(b/a).
With a interpreted as twice rms size, transverse averaged binomial distributions give a constant near.5-.577.
The local radial-field derivation assumes longitudinal variation scale large compared with the pipe radius.
contrast_inference: A single transverse-independent g does not promise pointwise accuracy at individual targets, and the pipe result does not directly transfer to our open elliptical source.

sources.title: Models of longitudinal space-charge impedance for microbunching instability
locations: SecIV and conclusion on shot-noise validity
facts: Frequency-dependent free-space longitudinal impedance for fixed round uniform transverse profile is reviewed; its low-frequency form contains log(k a/gamma), not a universal constant g.
Paper distinguishes on-axis fields, transverse shape assumptions and 1D shot-noise validity.
Shot-noise 1D/3D disagreement becomes significant around k rb/gamma>=.5; this is a result for its stochastic ultrarelativistic setup, not a universal1% criterion for our tube.
Conducting pipe changes low-frequency response; free-space and chamber kernels differ.
contrast_inference: A nonlocal longitudinal kernel is a literature-based route to finite-end response, but a straight round ultrarelativistic result must be generalized before applying it quantitatively to our slow, curved elliptical source.

sources.title: Analysis of the longitudinal space charge impedance of a round uniform beam inside parallel plates and rectangular chambers
facts: Exact-image-beam formulation treats arbitrary longitudinal modulation wavelengths; includes free-space direct field, round-pipe comparison, plates and rectangular walls.
On-axis and transverse-averaged impedance are distinct.
Validation includes a20keV H2+ example beta about.0046/gamma about1, beam radius5mm, SIR circumference6.58m; rectangular chamber11.4x4.8cm.
Full-spectrum formulas agree with finite-element calculations while the long-wavelength approximation overestimates short-wavelength impedance.
contrast_inference: Relevant low-beta and5mm-scale evidence for replacing a constant-g closure with wavelength-dependent response; it remains a straight round coasting/harmonic model, not direct validation of our finite143-degree elliptical arc.

unresolved: No source explicitly derives numeric6.36 for its plotted Gaussian example parameters; the thesis identifies shape-dependent g0 and the example but does not prove universal value or original OPALX developer intent.

project_contrast.hard_ends: No finite slow longitudinal variation scale; high-k content extends beyond local long-wavelength validity.
project_contrast.our_5mm_probe: An end-distance comparable to radial semiaxis is not an asymptotic interior long-wavelength test.
project_contrast.model_point: Multiplying lambda-prime by any finite constant g cannot produce a nonzero field at an interior point where lambda-prime=0; this is our inference, independently of code boundary choices.
